images.title: Constructing the perpendicular bisector
images.purpose: Show the finished construction of the perpendicular bisector of XY, with both pairs of arcs.
images.composition: One construction in the centre: the segment XY horizontal, the bisector vertical.
exact_structure: A horizontal dark segment XY with labels X (left) and Y (right).
Above XY, a grey (#6B7280) arc centred at X and a grey (#6B7280) arc centred at Y, of the same radius, more than half of XY, crossing at A.
Below XY, the same two arcs continued, crossing at B.
A teal (#0072B2) straight line through A and B, crossing XY at its midpoint O.
A small square right angle mark at O.
Labels A, B and O beside their points.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Two pairs of equal arcs give two points; the line through them is the perpendicular bisector.
images.description: Show the finished construction of the perpendicular bisector of XY, with both pairs of arcs.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.

image_decisions.why: Seeing where each arc is centred helps students copy the steps exactly.
